nodes.description: bool private swapping; reentrancy/skip guard around the swap-and-send block inside _transfer.
PTPDividendTracker public dividendTracker; external contract that receives dividends and tracks holder balances.
IUniswapV2Router02 public uniswapV2Router; external DEX router used to swap tokens for ETH.
address public liquidityWallet; destination of swapped ETH and of the liquidity added by addLiquidity.
uint256 public swapTokensAtAmount; contract token balance threshold that triggers the swap logic.
uint256 public gasForProcessing; gas forwarded to dividendTracker.process on every transfer.
mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFees; accounts exempt from token fees.
mapping(address => bool) public automatedMarketMakerPairs; marks DEX pairs (sell paths) for the increased fee factor.
uint256 public immutable totalFees; combined ETH rewards + liquidity fee used in the fee formula.
PlayTimeProfit._transfer: takes fees, performs swaps, updates dividend balances and processes the dividend tracker.
PlayTimeProfit.swapAndSendToOwner: swaps tokens for ETH and forwards the delta to owner() via a low-level call.
PlayTimeProfit.swapTokensForEth: approves the router and performs swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp as deadline.
PlayTimeProfit.swapAndSendDividends: swaps tokens for ETH then forwards the whole balance to the dividend tracker via a low-level call.
PlayTimeProfit.processDividendTracker: externally callable public processing loop that emits the processor as tx.origin.
PlayTimeProfit.claim: withdraws the caller's dividends through dividendTracker.processAccount.
PlayTimeProfit.updateDividendTracker: onlyOwner replacement of the dividend tracker contract (privileged state change).
PlayTimeProfit.setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: onlyOwner toggling of AMM pair classification and dividend exclusion.
PlayTimeProfit.updateGasForProcessing: onlyOwner update of the gas budget used for the dividend loop.
PlayTimeProfit.updateLiquidityWallet: onlyOwner replacement of the liquidity wallet address.
DividendPayingToken.distributeDividends: payable entry point (also reachable via receive) that magnifies and credits incoming ETH.
DividendPayingToken._withdrawDividendOfUser: computes the dividend, records the withdrawal and sends ETH with a low-level call.
DividendPayingToken.withdrawDividend: public wrapper that forwards payable(msg.sender) to _withdrawDividendOfUser (reverting in PTPDividendTracker).
PTPDividendTracker.processAccount: onlyOwner payout that stores block.timestamp as lastClaimTimes for the account.
PTPDividendTracker.process: unbounded-iteration, gas-metered loop over token holders that claims dividends.
PTPDividendTracker.setBalance: onlyOwner rebalancing via mint/burn that then calls processAccount.
PTPDividendTracker.canAutoClaim: block.timestamp based eligibility predicate for automatic claims.
PlayTimeProfit.updateClaimWait: onlyOwner forwarded configuration of the tracker claim wait.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for dividend accounting, dividend withdrawal target and context.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time used for swap deadlines and claim eligibility.
tx.origin: the EOA origin of the transaction, used as the 'processor' identity in events.
Low-level ETH transfer user.call{value: _withdrawableDividend, gas: 3000}("") inside _withdrawDividendOfUser, executed after the withdrawnDividends state update.
Low-level ETH transfer owner().call{value: newBalance}("") inside swapAndSendToOwner; requires success.
Low-level ETH transfer address(dividendTracker).call{value: dividends}("") inside swapAndSendDividends: forwards the whole contract balance to an arbitrary tracker.
External call into the user-configurable uniswapV2Router (swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens / addLiquidityETH) with amountOutMin = 0.
Parameter from of PlayTimeProfit._transfer: sender address used for fee checks, dividend rebalancing and swap trigger conditions.
Parameter to of PlayTimeProfit._transfer: recipient address used for AMM sell detection and dividend rebalancing.
Parameter amount of PlayTimeProfit._transfer: transfer amount from which fees are derived.
Parameter newAddress of updateDividendTracker: attacker-controllable only by owner, becomes the new tracker.
Parameter newValue of updateGasForProcessing: new gas budget forwarded to dividend processing.
Parameter account of PTPDividendTracker.processAccount: the holder whose dividend is paid out.
Local variable contractTokenBalance in _transfer: balanceOf(address(this)) compared against swapTokensAtAmount.
Local variable fees in _transfer: amount.mul(totalFees).div(100) optionally scaled by sellFeeIncreaseFactor.
Local variable gas in _transfer: snapshot of gasForProcessing passed to dividendTracker.process.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the distributor recorded in DividendsDistributed and drives the magnified dividend accounting.
withdrawDividend forwards payable(msg.sender) as the withdrawal beneficiary.
The user address that receives the ETH dividend in _withdrawDividendOfUser is derived from msg.sender.
The low-level ETH call target is an address controlled by msg.sender, so the callee code is attacker supplied.
claim() passes msg.sender as the account argument of processAccount.
block.timestamp is used as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution time miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is written into lastClaimTimes to rate-limit dividend claims.
canAutoClaim compares block.timestamp with lastClaimTime + claimWait to decide automatic claims.
tx.origin is read inside _transfer and emitted as the processor address of ProcessedDividendTracker.
processDividendTracker emits tx.origin as the processor, leaking/trusting the transaction origin.
gasForProcessing bounds the dividend tracker processing loop triggered at the end of every transfer.
dividendTracker.setBalance(x2) and process(gas) are invoked inside _transfer on every token move.
dividendTracker is the recipient of the swapped ETH in swapAndSendDividends.
_isExcludedFromFees[from]/[to] disables fee taking for the transfer participants.
automatedMarketMakerPairs[to] selects the increased sell fee factor and pairs are excluded from swap triggering.
swapping gates the swap/send block and disables fee taking while swapping.
totalFees is the denominator/numerator of the fee split between liquidity and dividends.
liquidityWallet is excluded from swap triggering and receives the liquidity portion.
swapTokensAtAmount is the contract balance threshold that enables the swap branch.
contractTokenBalance is compared to swapTokensAtAmount to decide whether to swap.
fees = amount.mul(totalFees).div(100) (optionally scaled by sellFeeIncreaseFactor) is the fee arithmetic of _transfer.
local gas is loaded from gasForProcessing and used for the dividend processing call.
The local fee value is computed by multiplying the untrusted amount parameter by the fee constants.
The from parameter controls exclusion/AMM checks and the dividend balance update of the sender.
The to parameter determines sell-fee treatment and the recipient dividend balance update.
The amount parameter is the value transferred and the base of the fee computation.
newAddress becomes the new dividendTracker after ownership checks.
newValue becomes gasForProcessing within the allowed 200k-500k range.
account is the holder paid by processAccount and whose lastClaimTimes is stamped with block.timestamp.
uniswapV2Router is the external contract approving and executing the token->ETH swap.
swapTokensForEth invokes swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on the router with amountOutMin = 0.
withdrawDividend calls _withdrawDividendOfUser(payable(msg.sender)).
_transfer calls swapAndSendToOwner(swapTokens) when the balance threshold is reached.
_transfer calls swapAndSendDividends(sellTokens) with the remaining contract balance.
swapAndSendToOwner calls swapTokensForEth(tokens).
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForEth(tokens) before forwarding the ETH.
_transfer wraps dividendTracker.setBalance for both from and to in try/catch.
_transfer calls dividendTracker.process(gas) inside try/catch when not swapping.
processDividendTracker calls dividendTracker.process(gas) and emits the result.
claim() calls dividendTracker.processAccount(payable(msg.sender), false).
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser(account) to obtain the payout amount.
The process loop calls processAccount(payable(account), true) for each eligible holder.
process calls canAutoClaim(lastClaimTimes[account]) before processing an account.
setBalance finishes by calling processAccount(account, true).
updateDividendTracker overwrites the dividendTracker state variable.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs via _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair calls dividendTracker.excludeFromDividends(pair) when value is true.
updateGasForProcessing writes gasForProcessing.
updateLiquidityWallet writes liquidityWallet and excludes the new wallet from fees.
updateClaimWait forwards the new value to dividendTracker.updateClaimWait.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs a low-level ETH call to the user (gas capped at 3000) after crediting withdrawnDividends; the callee can re-enter the token/tracker flow.
swapAndSendToOwner performs a low-level ETH call to owner() while the caller is still inside _transfer (swapping flag true), an externally controlled callback.
swapAndSendDividends performs a low-level ETH call to the dividend tracker, forwarding the entire contract balance; a malicious tracker can re-enter.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only meaningful as the sender argument of _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
to is only meaningful as the recipient/AMM-pair argument of _transfer and should be folded into that function node.
amount is the transfer value consumed by _transfer's fee and accounting logic.
newAddress is used only to validate and install the new dividend tracker.
newValue is validated and stored into gasForProcessing inside this function.
account is the payout target handled entirely inside processAccount.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local computed and consumed only inside _transfer.
fees is the temporary fee amount computed and immediately spent inside _transfer.
gas is a snapshot of gasForProcessing used only as an argument of dividendTracker.process inside _transfer.
